rules.name: Per-tag load rules gated on OneTrust consent groups
rules.from: webtags.logitech.com/logi/prod/utag.js utag.loader.cfg (offset ~223460) and utag.cond cases reading cp.OptanonConsent / js_page.OnetrustActiveGroups (offset ~49208)

dataElements.name: utag_data (UDO)
dataElements.source: utag_data: page_name, page_type, page_category_name, site_locale, site_country, site_language, link_text, link_url …

Tealium.notes: Tealium profile logitech/logi/prod (ut4, build 202610292328) is self-hosted on webtags.logitech.com and injects the Google gtag/Ads/Floodlight, Meta, Reddit, Marketo, Quantum Metric, Bizible, ZoomInfo, Impact and Siteimprove tags; its load rules read the OneTrust cookie (`OptanonConsent` C0002/C0003/C0004), so consent gating already happens inside Tealium (per-tag). The migrated pages must set `utag_data` with the same keys before utag.js loads, or the owner remaps the UDO in Tealium.
